subject: Original synthetic I1 stepped shaft: three coaxial steps along +X, diameters 30/20/12 mm, lengths 20/40/20 mm, middle diameter deviations -0.01/+0.02 mm. Not taken from any customer drawing.
origin: Modelled in SolidCraft 0.27.0 and drawn through CADCraft 0.15.1+aixcam.1 (saved and reopened) in the private development repository of the drawing route; the DWG is shipped here unchanged.

converter.fonts: None: the conversion runs without SHX fonts and the rendering uses the converter's built-in stroke font.

scope: Public input of the drawing route and its tests. Passing route checks on it says nothing about engineering correctness or about other drawings.
